name: Meta Harness
description: Discover, configure, document, track, and run coding agent harnesses through Total Recall across mesh nodes.

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Inspect local agent binaries and authentication metadata

subcommands.name: catalog
subcommands.description: List documented adapter contracts and source references

subcommands.name: nodes
subcommands.description: List recorded mesh targets without probing or changing them

subcommands.name: inspect
subcommands.description: Inspect installed harnesses on a selected node

subcommands.name: run-command
subcommands.description: Run an explicit plugin command through the selected agent and node using a JSON request on stdin

subcommands.name: runtime
subcommands.description: Manage any agent runtime; includes Hermes gateway/auth/skills/plugins and DSH observations

subcommands.name: dispatch
subcommands.description: Run a task from stdin after automatic Total Recall bootstrap

subcommands.name: docs-status
subcommands.description: Verify cached official documentation coverage freshness and hashes

subcommands.name: docs-refresh
subcommands.description: Download complete official agent documentation and retain last-good content on failure

subcommands.name: docs-ensure
subcommands.description: Refresh missing or stale documentation automatically

subcommands.name: maintenance
subcommands.description: Daemon maintenance: official documentation and integration surfaces, or the model catalog with --models

args.name: models
args.label: Refresh the model and benchmark catalog

subcommands.name: setup
subcommands.description: Configure supported agent instruction surfaces and daemon task placement

subcommands.name: docs-sources
subcommands.description: List approved official documentation sources

subcommands.name: docs-read
subcommands.description: Read integrity-checked cached official documentation

subcommands.name: docs-search
subcommands.description: Search downloaded official documentation

subcommands.name: upstream
subcommands.description: Probe latest upstream harness versions and update availability

subcommands.name: changelog
subcommands.description: Inspect recent official changelog highlights for a selected agent

subcommands.name: adapter
subcommands.description: Manage extensible harness adapter definitions (list, add, remove)

args.name: target
args.label: File path, spec JSON, or adapter ID

subcommands.name: quota
subcommands.description: Inspect 5-hour rolling/weekly quotas, credit balances, and host RAM

subcommands.name: benchmarks
subcommands.description: Sourced model pricing, coding index and leaderboard results, with pass rates measured on this machine

subcommands.name: route
subcommands.description: Choose the harness for a task; with --execute, run it on its own branch and escalate on failure

args.name: execute
args.label: Run the task on its own branch

args.name: gate
args.label: Require the code-quality gate, escalating when it fails

subcommands.name: coordinate
subcommands.description: Coordinate multi-agent specialized execution pipelines (pipeline, council, race)

args.name: execute
args.label: Run the agents; without this the plan is only reported

args.name: allowSameFamily
args.label: Accept a Verifier from the Implementer's model family

subcommands.name: learn
subcommands.description: Summarize run receipts into scorecards and quota walls; --emit writes proposals to memory

args.name: emit
args.label: Write proposals through the memory owner

subcommands.name: alerts
subcommands.description: Send operator alerts for quota walls and usage over the threshold

args.name: threshold
args.label: Usage percent that triggers an alert

subcommands.name: decompose
subcommands.description: Decompose complex multi-step tasks into specialized Explorer, Architect, Implementer, and Verifier subagent stages

subcommands.name: orchestrate
subcommands.description: Orchestrate multi-step tasks using subagent fan-out, one-way valve context compression, and cross-model verification

args.name: orchestrator
args.label: Active orchestrator harness (claude, codex, agy, hermes, cursor)

args.name: autoReview
args.label: Trigger adversarial code review upon completion

args.name: allowSameFamily
args.label: Accept a Verifier from the Implementer's model family

subcommands.name: threads
subcommands.description: Manage multi-platform agent threads, PR branch tracking, and turn history across all connected platforms

subcommands.name: review
subcommands.description: Execute automated adversarial cross-model code review on Git diffs, PR branches, or staged changes

args.name: target
args.label: Target branch, PR commit, or empty for working-tree

args.name: author
args.label: Harness that wrote the code, excluded with its model family

args.name: thread
args.label: Thread to attach the review to

tasks.intent: Keep official agent documentation and Total Recall integrations current
Automated daily model and benchmark catalog refresh into offline living documents
